description: Buy USDC with the owner's OWN fiat and deliver it to the agent's wallet (address locked). Returns checkoutUrl (valid ~2 hours) + partnerOrderId. Paid endpoint ($0.01 USDC via x402) — this package pays it automatically from AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY, so the call succeeds without you seeing a 402. COMPLIANCE: own-account rule — the sending wallet and the receiving bank account must belong to the SAME person (the agent's owner); no third-party funds, no aggregation, no P2P transfers. 18+; service area: Portugal + supported EU/EEA countries (NOT the UK). Crypto is volatile; not investment advice.

callbackUrl.description: Optional public https URL stored for a future provider with status webhooks — the current provider sends none, so no push will arrive and no callback secret is issued. Poll get_order_status instead

email.description: Owner's account email. If provided, the checkout link is ALSO emailed to this address automatically (you still receive it in checkoutUrl); the response echoes emailedTo to confirm

payment.description: Base64 of a single x402 v2 PaymentPayload you signed yourself. OPTIONAL: with AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY set, this tool pays automatically and you never need it. Use it to pay from a DIFFERENT wallet, or when no key is configured — call once without it to get the 402 (its body carries `howToPay.payloadTemplate`, the exact envelope to sign), then call again with it. When set it is sent as-is as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header; no local signing and no price ceiling are applied.

provider.description: Licensed fiat provider. `mtpelerin` is the only provider on this server and the default — omit this field. It settles by SEPA bank transfer across the SEPA zone (incl. Portugal); its order status is not push-updated. Any other value returns 400 (no other provider is configured on this server).

ref.description: Optional referral code (1-64 chars: letters, digits, _ or -)

walletAddress.description: Agent wallet that receives USDC (0x…, EIP-55 checked)

walletCode.description: Optional Mt Pelerin address lock, part 1: 4-digit code (1000-9999). Requires walletHash

walletHash.description: Optional Mt Pelerin address lock, part 2: base64 signature of 'MtPelerin-<code>' by the agent's OWN wallet key (never shared with us). Locks the widget to walletAddress. Requires walletCode

name: create_onramp_session

checkoutUrl.description: Branded checkout URL (valid ~2 hours) — forward to the human owner

customerKey.description: Returned ONCE on the first session with a new customerId — store securely

emailedTo.description: Present when an `email` was supplied and email is configured: the checkout link was also emailed to this address (best-effort)

partnerOrderId.description: Order id — track it with get_order_status

provider.description: Licensed fiat provider handling this session (e.g. mtpelerin)

title: Create on-ramp session (fiat → USDC)
